name: fix_null_pointer_service
description: Fixes a NullPointerException when an order has no gift message
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, OrderService.describeGift(Order order) (src/main/java/com/optarena/orders/OrderService.java) throws a NullPointerException whenever order.getGiftMessage() is null, because most orders have no gift message. Fix describeGift so that: when getGiftMessage() is null, it returns exactly the string "Gift note: (none)"; when getGiftMessage() is non-null, it returns "Gift note: " followed by the message with leading/trailing whitespace trimmed. Do not change the method signature or the Order class.
